intermediate.name: Goniace / San Martino
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (4) Goniace / San Martino (156.1 km)

story: A big crash in the peloton 23 kilometer from the finish split up the peloton, causing key contenders like Roglic and Ayuso lose time on leader del Toro. Kasper Asgreen took the win from the early break after impressively holding on to a small margin.
